notes.title: Optimized for Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
[p]We're excited to announce that [b]Into The Zone[/b] is fully compatible with the Steam Deck! We know that a smooth, portable experience is important, and we've put in the work to ensure the game feels great right out of the box.
[/p][p][b]Ready to Go, Right Away[/b]
You can jump into the chaos of the Zone with confidence. [b]Into The Zone[/b] works perfectly with the [b]default Steam Deck controller layout[/b], which means you don't have to fiddle with any settings to get started. All the core moves—from throwing your hammer to teleporting to your target—are intuitively mapped to the Steam Deck's built-in controls.
[/p][p]Everything you need is there:[/p][list][*][p]Fluid, responsive combat using the Steam Deck's sticks and buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Clear and readable user interface elements and text.[/p][/*][*][p]A consistently smooth frame rate for the fast-paced, zone-based action.[/p][/*][/list][p]So what are you waiting for? Fight it out with your friends in the Zone on your Steam Deck![/p]
